issue-4204: Monday summary email arrives on Tuesday
Opened by n.okafor on 2026-09-11

My Monday summary email shows up on Tuesday morning, every week. I'm in Sydney.
Colleagues in London get theirs on Monday as expected. Our account settings
have the right time zone for each of us.

args.title: Fix scheduled export timing to respect recipient time zones
args.body: File: src/export/scheduler.ts. The scheduler computes nextRunAt using a fixed RUN_HOUR_UTC and weekly/monthly offsets purely in UTC, with no awareness of the report's or recipients' configured time zone. This means users far from UTC (e.g. Sydney, UTC+10/11) can have their "Monday morning" run land on Tuesday local time, while users closer to UTC (e.g. London) see the expected day. The fix should make nextRunAt (and/or runScheduledExport) take the report's configured time zone into account when computing the next scheduled run and the cutover day/hour, instead of assuming all recipients share the UTC calendar day.
